span.p:
State space model
population as a slowly changing
hidden number, with birth,
death and predation terms

always on, no counting,
unaffected by turbidity

span.p:
Camera count
frequent, noisy, biased low

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

Known events
restock, found death, transfer

span.p:
